question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, e.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, d.CITY, d.STATE, d.POSTAL_CODE FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS d JOIN FCLT_ROOMS a ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY b ON a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = b.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY c ON b.DLC_KEY = c.DLC_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS e ON e.BUILDING_KEY = d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE lower(c.DLC_NAME) = lower('History') AND d.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY, 
    BUILDINGS.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.CITY, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.STATE, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.POSTAL_CODE 
FROM 
    BUILDINGS 
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY 
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY 
JOIN 
    FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY 
JOIN 
    MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY 
WHERE 
    MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME = 'History Department';
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 
    BUILDINGS.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.CITY, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.STATE, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.POSTAL_CODE
FROM 
    MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY
JOIN 
    FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS ON FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE 
    MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME = 'History Department';

question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.activity_title, d.session_location, c.term_start_date, b.person_name AS Leader FROM iap_subject_detail a JOIN iap_subject_person b ON a.iap_subject_person_key = b.iap_subject_person_key JOIN academic_terms_all c ON c.term_code = a.term_code JOIN iap_subject_session d ON a.iap_subject_session_key = d.iap_subject_session_key WHERE b.person_role = 'Activity leader' ORDER BY term_start_date ASC;
sql_baseline:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_LOCATION, 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_START_DATE, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON.PERSON_NAME 
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL 
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY 
JOIN 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE 
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON ON IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY 
ORDER BY 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_START_DATE ASC;
sql_agg:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_LOCATION, 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_START_DATE, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON.PERSON_NAME
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
ORDER BY 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_START_DATE ASC;

question: List the unique course instructor names, course titles, and the amount of material for each course instructor key and the key of subject offered.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR.instructor_name, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.subject_title, COUNT(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG.catalog_isbn) OVER (PARTITION BY LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY;
sql_baseline:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    LCI.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, 
    LSO.SUBJECT_TITLE, 
    COUNT(LRCD.CATALOG_ISBN) AS amount_of_material, 
    LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
FROM 
    LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR LCI
JOIN 
    LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL LRM ON LCI.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = LRM.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN 
    LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = LSO.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG LRCD ON LRM.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = LRCD.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY 
    LCI.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, 
    LSO.SUBJECT_TITLE, 
    LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;
sql_agg:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    LCI.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, 
    LSO.SUBJECT_TITLE, 
    COUNT(LRCD.CATALOG_ISBN) AS amount_of_material, 
    LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
FROM 
    LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR LCI
JOIN 
    LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL LRM ON LCI.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = LRM.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN 
    LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = LSO.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG LRCD ON LRM.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = LRCD.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY 
    LCI.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, 
    LSO.SUBJECT_TITLE, 
    LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT fac_rooms.Room, fac_rooms.floor, fac_building_address.BUILDING_KEY, BUILDINGS.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fac_building_address.CITY, fac_building_address.STATE, fac_building_address.POSTAL_CODE FROM (SELECT office_location FROM employee_directory WHERE full_name = 'Haynes, Summer') AS emp_office JOIN fac_rooms ON emp_office.office_location = fac_rooms.fac_room_key JOIN fac_building_address ON fac_rooms.building_key = fac_building_address.BUILDING_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS ON BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY = fac_building_address.BUILDING_KEY WHERE fac_building_address.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    FR.ROOM, 
    FR.FLOOR, 
    FBA.BUILDING_KEY, 
    B.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    FBA.CITY, 
    FBA.STATE, 
    FBA.POSTAL_CODE 
FROM 
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ED 
JOIN 
    FAC_ROOMS FR ON ED.OFFICE_LOCATION = FR.FAC_ROOM_KEY 
JOIN 
    FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS FBA ON FR.BUILDING_KEY = FBA.BUILDING_KEY 
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS B ON FBA.BUILDING_KEY = B.BUILDING_KEY 
WHERE 
    ED.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer';
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    FAC_ROOMS.ROOM, 
    FAC_ROOMS.FLOOR, 
    FAC_ROOMS.BUILDING_KEY, 
    BUILDINGS.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS.CITY, 
    FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS.STATE, 
    FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS.POSTAL_CODE
FROM 
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY
JOIN 
    FAC_ROOMS ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_LOCATION = FAC_ROOMS.FAC_ROOM_KEY
JOIN 
    FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FAC_ROOMS.BUILDING_KEY = FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS ON FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_KEY = BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE 
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer';

question: List the unique full room names, their corresponding building names, street addresses, cities, states, postal codes, and building heights for rooms associated with subjects that Computer Science students can enroll in.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON MEET_PLACE = FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';
sql_baseline:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    FCLT_ROOMS.ROOM_FULL_NAME, 
    BUILDINGS.BUILDING_NAME, 
    BUILDINGS.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.CITY, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.STATE, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.POSTAL_CODE, 
    FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci';
sql_agg:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    FCLT_ROOMS.ROOM_FULL_NAME, 
    BUILDINGS.BUILDING_NAME, 
    BUILDINGS.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.CITY, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.STATE,

    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED 
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY 
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY 
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY 
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY 
WHERE 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci';

question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.TERM_CODE, s.subject_title, fr.room, fr.floor, b.BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, s.form_type, s.num_enrolled_students FROM subject_offered s JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON MEET_PLACE = FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS b ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY WHERE s.num_enrolled_students > 300 AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';
sql_baseline:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    SO.TERM_CODE, 
    SO.SUBJECT_TITLE, 
    FR.ROOM, 
    FR.FLOOR, 
    B.BUILDING_KEY, 
    B.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    FBA.CITY, 
    FBA.STATE, 
    FBA.POSTAL_CODE, 
    SO.FORM_TYPE, 
    SO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM 
    SUBJECT_OFFERED SO
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FR.MEET_PLACE = SO.SUBJECT_KEY
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS FBA ON FBA.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS B ON B.BUILDING_KEY = FR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE 
    SO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 300;
sql_agg:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    so.TERM_CODE, 
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE, 
    fr.ROOM, 
    fr.FLOOR, 
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 
    ba.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    ba.CITY, 
    ba.STATE, 
    ba.POSTAL_CODE, 
    so.FORM_TYPE, 
    so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM 
    SUBJECT_OFFERED so
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fr.MEET_PLACE = so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba ON ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE 
    so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 300;

question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, new shelf prices, and total costs of new materials for each subject title, sorted by individual item prices in ascending order?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tm.title, tm.isbn, tm.new_shelf_price, SUM(tm.new_shelf_price) OVER(PARTITION BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE) FROM tip_material tm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY tm.new_shelf_price ASC;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, 
    tm.TITLE AS MATERIAL_TITLE, 
    tm.ISBN, 
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS TOTAL_COST
FROM 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
ORDER BY 
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, 
    tm.TITLE AS MATERIAL_TITLE, 
    tm.ISBN, 
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS TOTAL_COST
FROM 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
ORDER BY 
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC;

question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.year_built, COUNT(employee_directory.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.year_built) AS num_employees FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM STR_TO_DATE(date_built, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS year_built FROM fclt_building_hist) AS sub1 WHERE year_built < 1950) AS a JOIN fclt_rooms ON fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MIT_ID, OFFICE_LOCATION FROM employee_directory) AS employee_directory ON employee_directory.OFFICE_LOCATION = fclt_rooms.BUILDING_ROOM) AS sub2 WHERE num_employees > 100;
sql_baseline:
SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.DATE_BUILT, COUNT(EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID) AS number_of_employees
FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON FCLT_ROOMS.BUILDING_ROOM = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_LOCATION
WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.DATE_BUILT < '01-JAN-1950'
GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.DATE_BUILT
HAVING COUNT(EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID) > 100;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.DATE_BUILT, 
    COUNT(EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID) AS number_of_employees
FROM 
    FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_LOCATION = FCLT_ROOMS.BUILDING_ROOM
WHERE 
    FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.DATE_BUILT < '01-JAN-1950'
GROUP BY 
    FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, 
    FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.DATE_BUILT
HAVING 
    COUNT(EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID) > 100;

question: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?
gold_sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.subject_id) FROM cis_course_catalog ccc JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 
    FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, 
    COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS number_of_courses
FROM 
    FCLT_BUILDING
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.BUILDING_ROOM = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID
JOIN 
    CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE 
    CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Center for International Studies'
GROUP BY 
    FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 
    FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 
    FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, 
    COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS course_count
FROM 
    FCLT_BUILDING
JOIN 
    FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.BUILDING_ROOM = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID
JOIN 
    CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE 
    CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Center for International Studies'
GROUP BY 
    FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 
    FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME;

question: What is the name of the building that accomodates the most students, and how many students does it accomodate?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT building_name, num_students FROM (SELECT fclt_building_key, COUNT(DISTINCT full_name) AS num_students FROM fclt_rooms JOIN mit_student_directory ON office_location = BUILDING_ROOM GROUP BY fclt_building_key) AS a JOIN fclt_building ON a.fclt_building_key = fclt_building.fclt_building_key JOIN (SELECT MAX(num_students) AS max_num_students FROM (SELECT fclt_building_key, COUNT(DISTINCT full_name) AS num_students FROM fclt_rooms JOIN mit_student_directory ON office_location = BUILDING_ROOM GROUP BY fclt_building_key) AS subquery1) AS b ON a.num_students = b.max_num_students;
sql_baseline:
SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.FULL_NAME) AS student_count
FROM FCLT_BUILDING
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON FCLT_ROOMS.BUILDING_ROOM = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_LOCATION
GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
sql_agg:
SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.FULL_NAME) AS student_count
FROM FCLT_BUILDING
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON FCLT_ROOMS.BUILDING_ROOM = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_LOCATION
GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: List the name and floor of the building with the largest floor number.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT B.BUILDING_NAME, A.FLOOR FROM FAC_FLOOR A JOIN FAC_BUILDING B ON A.BUILDING_KEY = B.FAC_BUILDING_KEY JOIN (SELECT MAX(f) AS highest_floor FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN FLOOR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS f FROM FAC_FLOOR) AS subquery1) AS subquery2 ON (CASE WHEN A.FLOOR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(A.FLOOR AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END) = subquery2.highest_floor;
sql_baseline:
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, f.FLOOR
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = f.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE f.FLOOR = (SELECT MAX(FLOOR) FROM FAC_FLOOR);
sql_agg:
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, f.FLOOR
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = f.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE f.FLOOR = (SELECT MAX(FLOOR) FROM FAC_FLOOR)

question: For each IAP category and academic year, list the category name, academic year, total fee collected, total number of IAP subjects, and the minimum and maximum enrollment.
gold_sql: SELECT isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(isd.FEE) AS Total_Fee, COUNT(distinct isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects, MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Min_Attendance, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Max_Attendance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY JOIN TIME_DAY td ON isd.TERM_CODE = td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    td.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    SUM(isd.FEE) AS total_fee_collected,

    MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS min_enrollment,

    TIME_DAY td ON td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = isd.TERM_CODE

question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.
gold_sql: SELECT issr.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS Total_Sessions, SUM(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT), MIN(isd.FEE) AS Min_Fee, MAX(isd.FEE) AS Max_Fee, SUM(CASE WHEN iss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Num_Sessions_With_Info, SUM(CASE WHEN iss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Num_Sessions_Without_Info FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR issr ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = issr.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY issr.SPONSOR_NAME;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    s.SPONSOR_NAME,
    COUNT(ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS number_of_sessions,
    SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_enrollment,
    MIN(d.FEE) AS minimum_fee,
    MAX(d.FEE) AS maximum_fee,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_with_info,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_without_info
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY 
    s.SPONSOR_NAME;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    s.SPONSOR_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ses.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS number_of_sessions,
    SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_enrollment,
    MIN(d.FEE) AS minimum_fee,
    MAX(d.FEE) AS maximum_fee,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ses.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS sessions_with_info,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ses.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS sessions_without_info
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ses ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ses.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY 
    s.SPONSOR_NAME;

question: What are the individual's email and name, academic year, total number of IAP subjects, the minimum and maximum fees, and the total course enrollment for each individual and academic year?
gold_sql: SELECT isp.PERSON_EMAIL, isp.PERSON_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(distinct isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects, MIN(isd.FEE) AS Min_Fee, MAX(isd.FEE) AS Max_Fee, SUM(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON isp JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON isp.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY JOIN TIME_DAY td ON isd.TERM_CODE = td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY isp.PERSON_EMAIL, isp.PERSON_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT 
    p.PERSON_EMAIL AS email,
    p.PERSON_NAME AS name,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_IAP_subjects,
    MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee,
    MAX(d.FEE) AS max_fee,
    SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_course_enrollment
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN 
    TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE
GROUP BY 
    p.PERSON_EMAIL, p.PERSON_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    p.PERSON_EMAIL AS email,
    p.PERSON_NAME AS name,

    MIN(d.FEE) AS minimum_fee,

    SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_course_enrollment
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN 
    TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE
GROUP BY 
    p.PERSON_EMAIL, p.PERSON_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: What is the term code, term description, total number of IAP sessions, total fee collected, and minimum and maximum enrollment for each term code?
gold_sql: SELECT isd.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(distinct iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS Total_Sessions, SUM(isd.FEE) AS Total_Fee, MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Min_Enrollment, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Max_Enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE GROUP BY isd.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE,
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    COUNT(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_sessions,
    SUM(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.FEE) AS total_fee_collected,
    MIN(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS min_enrollment,
    MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment
FROM 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    at.TERM_CODE, 
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, 
    COUNT(iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_sessions, 
    SUM(isd.FEE) AS total_fee_collected, 
    MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS min_enrollment, 
    MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment
FROM 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
LEFT JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON at.TERM_CODE = isd.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY 
    at.TERM_CODE, 
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: What is the name of the building, total number of subjects, total fee, and shortest and longest sessions for each physical IAP session location?
gold_sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects, SUM(isd.FEE) AS Total_Fee, MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'), CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') > STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p') ELSE STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') END)) AS Min_Sessions, MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'), CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') > STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p') ELSE STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') END)) AS Max_Sessions FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = iss.SESSION_LOCATION GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    B.BUILDING_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT D.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_subjects,
    SUM(D.FEE) AS total_fee,
    MIN(TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(D.SESSION_DATE, ' ', S.SESSION_START_TIME))) AS shortest_session,
    MAX(TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(D.SESSION_DATE, ' ', S.SESSION_END_TIME))) AS longest_session
FROM 
    BUILDINGS B
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION S ON B.BUILDING_NUMBER = S.SESSION_LOCATION
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL D ON S.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = D.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY 
    B.BUILDING_NAME;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    B.BUILDING_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT D.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_subjects,
    SUM(D.FEE) AS total_fee,
    MIN(TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(S.SESSION_DATE, ' ', S.SESSION_END_TIME))) AS shortest_session,
    MAX(TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(S.SESSION_DATE, ' ', S.SESSION_END_TIME))) AS longest_session
FROM 
    BUILDINGS B
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION S ON B.BUILDING_NUMBER = S.SESSION_LOCATION
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL D ON S.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = D.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY 
    B.BUILDING_NAME;

question: What is total number of subjects, the total fee, and the shortest and longest sessions, for all virtual IAP sessions?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects, SUM(isd.FEE) AS Total_Fee, MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'), CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') > STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p') ELSE STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') END)) AS Min_Sessions, MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'), CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') > STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p') ELSE STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') END)) AS Max_Sessions FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER != iss.SESSION_LOCATION;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_subjects,
    SUM(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.FEE) AS total_fee,
    MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_DATE, ' ', IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_START_TIME), '%Y-%m-%d %h%i%p'), 
        STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_DATE, ' ', IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_END_TIME), '%Y-%m-%d %h%i%p'))) AS shortest_session,
    MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_DATE, ' ', IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_START_TIME), '%Y-%m-%d %h%i%p'), 
        STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_DATE, ' ', IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_END_TIME), '%Y-%m-%d %h%i%p'))) AS longest_session
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ON IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_LOCATION LIKE 'On line';
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_subjects,
    SUM(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.FEE) AS total_fee,
    MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, STR_TO_DATE(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'), STR_TO_DATE(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'))) AS shortest_session,
    MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, STR_TO_DATE(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'), STR_TO_DATE(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'))) AS longest_session
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ON IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_LOCATION = 'On line';

question: What is the school code, school name, full name of the department, course level, total number of courses, and total number of degree-granting courses for each school code, department, and course level?
gold_sql: SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses, SUM(CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Degree_Granting_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, 
    cd.COURSE_LEVEL, 
    COUNT(cd.COURSE) AS total_courses, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM 
    SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
JOIN 
    SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN 
    SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, 
    cd.COURSE_LEVEL;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, 
    cd.COURSE_LEVEL, 
    COUNT(cd.COURSE) AS total_courses, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM 
    SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN 
    SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN 
    SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, 
    cd.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: What are the different schools and departments that offer SIS courses? List their school code, school name, department code, department name, the total number of phone numbers, and the most common course level.
gold_sql: SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS Total_Phone_Numbers, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'U' ELSE 'G' END AS Most_Common_Course_Level FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    s.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    s.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, 
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    COUNT(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS total_phone_numbers, 
    (SELECT COURSE_LEVEL 
     FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd 
     WHERE cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE 
     GROUP BY COURSE_LEVEL 
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS most_common_course_level
FROM 
    SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s
JOIN 
    SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = cd.COURSE
JOIN 
    SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN 
    SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    s.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    s.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, 
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    s.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    s.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, 
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    COUNT(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS total_phone_numbers, 
    (SELECT COURSE_LEVEL 
     FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd 
     WHERE cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE 
     GROUP BY COURSE_LEVEL 
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS most_common_course_level
FROM 
    SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s
JOIN 
    SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = cd.COURSE
JOIN 
    SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN 
    SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    s.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    s.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, 
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: What is the school code, school name, DLC key, the graduate level, total number of SIS subjects, the minimum and maximum course numbers, and the total number of departments offering subjects for each school?

SELECT 
    s.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    s.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DLC_KEY, 
    c.GRADUATE_LEVEL, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_sis_subjects, 
    MIN(s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS min_course_number, 
    MAX(s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS max_course_number, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments

JOIN

GROUP BY 
    s.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    s.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DLC_KEY, 
    c.GRADUATE_LEVEL;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    s.SCHOOL_CODE, 
    s.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    d.DLC_KEY, 
    c.GRADUATE_LEVEL, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sub.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_sis_subjects, 
    MIN(sub.COURSE_NUMBER) AS min_course_number, 
    MAX(sub.COURSE_NUMBER) AS max_course_number, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments

    SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s

    SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE

question: What is the building component, name of the building, square footage for all rooms, total number of floors, total number of rooms, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, and total number of supervisees for each building component?
gold_sql: SELECT sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, b.BUILDING_NAME, sd.Total_Square_Footage, COUNT(DISTINCT SF.FLOOR) AS Total_Number_Of_Floors, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms, COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) as Total_Number_FCLT, COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS Total_Supervisors, SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS Total_Supervisees FROM (SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.*, SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_COMPONENT) AS Total_Square_Footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, b.BUILDING_NAME, sd.Total_Square_Footage;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_floors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(su.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
FROM 
    SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS b ON sd.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN 
    SPACE_UNIT su ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
LEFT JOIN 
    SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
GROUP BY 
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, b.BUILDING_NAME;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_floors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(su.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
FROM 
    SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN 
    BUILDINGS b ON sd.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN 
    SPACE_UNIT su ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
LEFT JOIN 
    SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
GROUP BY 
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, b.BUILDING_NAME;

question: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each DLC?
gold_sql: SELECT su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS Total_Number_Of_Floors, sd.Total_Square_Footage, COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Total_Number_Facility, COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS Total_Supervisors, SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS Total_Supervisees, SUM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS Cumulative_Building_Height FROM (SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.*, SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_COMPONENT) AS Total_Square_Footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION) fo ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, sd.Total_Square_Footage;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    SU.DLC_KEY AS 'DLC key',
    FO.DLC_NAME AS 'name of the DLC',
    COUNT(DISTINCT SF.FLOOR) AS 'total number of floors',
    SUM(SD.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS 'total square footage',
    COUNT(DISTINCT SU.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS 'total number of facility organizations',
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUU.MIT_ID) AS 'total number of supervisors',
    SUM(SUU.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS 'total number of supervisees',
    SUM(FB.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS 'total building heights'
FROM 
    SPACE_UNIT SU
JOIN 
    SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE SUU ON SU.DLC_KEY = SUU.DEPT_NAMES
JOIN 
    SPACE_DETAIL SD ON SU.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = SD.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    SPACE_FLOOR SF ON SD.BUILDING_KEY = SF.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN 
    FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON SU.DLC_KEY = FO.DLC_KEY
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING FB ON SD.BUILDING_KEY = FB.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY 
    SU.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    SU.DLC_KEY AS 'DLC key',
    FO.DLC_NAME AS 'name of the DLC',
    COUNT(DISTINCT SF.FLOOR_KEY) AS 'total number of floors',
    SUM(SD.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS 'total square footage',
    COUNT(DISTINCT SU.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS 'total number of facility organizations',
    COUNT(DISTINCT SU.MIT_ID) AS 'total number of supervisors',
    SUM(SU.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS 'total number of supervisees',
    SUM(FB.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS 'total building heights'
FROM 
    SPACE_UNIT SU
JOIN 
    FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON SU.DLC_KEY = FO.DLC_KEY
JOIN 
    SPACE_FLOOR SF ON SU.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = SF.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN 
    SPACE_DETAIL SD ON SU.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = SD.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
JOIN 
    SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE SUU ON SU.DLC_KEY = SUU.DEPT_NAMES
JOIN 
    FCLT_BUILDING FB ON SD.BUILDING_KEY = FB.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY 
    SU.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME;

question: What is the department name, total number of types of TIP subjects, total number of enrolled students, the minimum and maximum rental new price for each department?
gold_sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(distinct tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students, MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS Min_Rental_New_Price, MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS Max_Rental_New_Price FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_types_of_tip_subjects,
    SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students,
    MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY 
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_types_of_tip_subjects,
    SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students,
    MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY 
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: What are the details of courses offered in the current academic term, including the academic year, term code, hgn code, the total number of types of courses, the average number of units, the department name, the name and email address of the person in charge?
gold_sql: SELECT CC.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CC.TERM_CODE, SO.HGN_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT CC.SUBJECT_ID) AS TOTAL_COURSES, AVG(CC.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVERAGE_UNITS, CC.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ED.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ED.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CC JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED SO ON CC.SUBJECT_ID = SO.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AT ON CC.TERM_CODE = AT.TERM_CODE JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ED ON SO.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ED.MIT_ID WHERE AT.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY CC.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CC.TERM_CODE, SO.HGN_CODE, CC.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ED.FULL_NAME, ED.EMAIL_ADDRESS;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_OFFERED.HGN_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_course_types,
    AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_units,
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.FULL_NAME,
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.EMAIL_ADDRESS
FROM 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS
JOIN 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE
JOIN 
    SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN 
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID
WHERE 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_OFFERED.HGN_CODE,
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.FULL_NAME,
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.EMAIL_ADDRESS;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    c.TERM_CODE,
    s.HGN_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses,
    AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_units,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    e.FULL_NAME,
    e.EMAIL_ADDRESS
FROM 
    COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN 
    SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE
JOIN 
    EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE 
    a.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY 
    c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, s.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.FULL_NAME, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS;

question: Retrieve information about the IAP subjects, including their titles, categories, session titles, session start time, session end time, sponsor names, and total number of sessions.
gold_sql: SELECT isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE, isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, iss.SESSION_TITLE, iss.SESSION_START_TIME, iss.SESSION_END_TIME, isp.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(distinct iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS Total_Sessions FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR isp ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = isp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE, isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, iss.SESSION_TITLE, iss.SESSION_START_TIME, iss.SESSION_END_TIME, isp.SPONSOR_NAME;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS titles,
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS categories,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_TITLE AS session_titles,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_START_TIME AS session_start_time,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_END_TIME AS session_end_time,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_names,
    COUNT(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_sessions
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY ON IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
GROUP BY 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_TITLE, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_START_TIME, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION.SESSION_END_TIME, 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR.SPONSOR_NAME;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    sd.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS title,
    sc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category,
    ss.SESSION_TITLE AS session_title,
    ss.SESSION_START_TIME AS session_start_time,
    ss.SESSION_END_TIME AS session_end_time,
    sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
    COUNT(ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_sessions
FROM 
    IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL sd
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY sc ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = sc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN 
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
GROUP BY 
    sd.ACTIVITY_TITLE, sc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ss.SESSION_TITLE, ss.SESSION_START_TIME, ss.SESSION_END_TIME, sp.SPONSOR_NAME;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, and the total number of courses per department.
gold_sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    s.SUBJECT_CODE, 
    s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, 
    c.GRADUATE_LEVEL, 
    COUNT(s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses
FROM 
    SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN 
    SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN 
    SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT
GROUP BY 
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    s.SUBJECT_CODE, 
    s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, 
    c.GRADUATE_LEVEL;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    s.SUBJECT_CODE, 
    s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, 
    c.GRADUATE_LEVEL, 
    COUNT(s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses
FROM 
    SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN 
    SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT
JOIN 
    SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE
GROUP BY 
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, c.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

question: For each term, list the term code, the term description, whether the term is current or not, and the total number of types of CIS courses.
gold_sql: SELECT at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM2, COUNT(DISTINCT at.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_SUBJECTS FROM (SELECT at.*, SUBJECT_ID, CASE WHEN at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_CURRENT_TERM2 FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.*, CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA' THEN 'Y' END AS A, CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%JA' THEN 'Y' END AS B, CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%SP' THEN 'Y' END AS C, CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU' THEN 'Y' END AS D FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL) at LEFT OUTER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND (IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = at.A OR IS_OFFERED_IAP = at.B OR IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = at.C OR IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = at.D)) at GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM2;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    ata.TERM_CODE, 
    ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, 
    atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM, 
    COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_cis_courses
FROM 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
LEFT JOIN 
    ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN 
    CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
GROUP BY 
    ata.TERM_CODE, 
    ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, 
    atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    ata.TERM_CODE, 
    ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, 
    atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_cis_courses
FROM 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
LEFT JOIN 
    ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN 
    CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON atp.TERM_CODE = ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
GROUP BY 
    ata.TERM_CODE, 
    ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, 
    atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM;

question: What is the author, school name, material status, total record counts, and total number of types of courses for each author and school?
gold_sql: SELECT tm.AUTHOR, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS Total_Record_Count , COUNT(distinct td.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN (select TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, CASE WHEN INSTR(AUTHOR, ';') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(AUTHOR, 1, INSTR(AUTHOR, ';') - 1) ELSE AUTHOR END AS AUTHOR FROM TIP_MATERIAL) tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY tm.AUTHOR, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, sd.SCHOOL_NAME;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    TM.AUTHOR, 
    SD.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 
    SUM(TD.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_record_counts, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT TD.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_number_of_types_of_courses
FROM 
    TIP_MATERIAL TM
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL TD ON TM.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = TD.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED TSO ON TSO.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TD.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS TMS ON TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = TD.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN 
    STUDENT_DEPARTMENT SD ON SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE = TSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    TM.AUTHOR, 
    SD.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    TM.AUTHOR, 
    SD.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 
    SUM(TD.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_record_counts, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT TD.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_number_of_types_of_courses
FROM 
    TIP_DETAIL TD
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL TM ON TD.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = TM.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS TMS ON TD.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED TSO ON TD.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TSO.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    STUDENT_DEPARTMENT SD ON TSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    TM.AUTHOR, 
    SD.SCHOOL_NAME, 
    TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

question: What is the course number, subject title, material status, the total, min, and max new shelf price, the total, min, and max used shelf price, total number of schools and the total number of materials for each TIP subject and material status?
gold_sql: SELECT tso.COURSE_NUMBER, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) as Total_New_Price, Min(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) as Min_New_Price, Max(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) as Max_New_Price, SUM(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) as Total_Used_Price, Min(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) as Min_Used_Price, Max(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) as Max_Used_Price, COUNT(DISTINCT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS Total_Num_Schools, COUNT(distinct td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS Total_Num_Materials FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.COURSE_NUMBER, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    so.COURSE_NUMBER,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_schools,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials,
    SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    MIN(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_new_shelf_price,
    MAX(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS max_new_shelf_price,
    SUM(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_used_shelf_price,
    MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_shelf_price,
    MAX(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS max_used_shelf_price
FROM 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED so
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL td ON so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL m ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY 
    so.COURSE_NUMBER, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_schools,
    COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials,
    SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    MIN(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_new_shelf_price,
    MAX(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS max_new_shelf_price,
    SUM(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_used_shelf_price,
    MIN(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_shelf_price,
    MAX(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS max_used_shelf_price
FROM 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY 
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

question: What is material status, the total number of materials, the total number of subjects, the total number of schools, and the most recent publication year for each material status?
gold_sql: SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS Total_Materials, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS Total_Num_Schools, MAX(tm.YEAR) AS Most_Recent_Year FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TD.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TD.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SD.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_schools,
    MAX(TM.YEAR) AS most_recent_publication_year
FROM 
    TIP_DETAIL TD
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL TM ON TD.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = TM.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS TMS ON TD.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED TSO ON TD.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TSO.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    STUDENT_DEPARTMENT SD ON TSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TD.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TD.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SD.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_schools,
    MAX(TM.YEAR) AS most_recent_publication_year
FROM 
    TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS TMS
LEFT JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL TD ON TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = TD.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL TM ON TD.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = TM.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED TSO ON TD.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TSO.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN 
    STUDENT_DEPARTMENT SD ON TSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    TMS.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

question: What is the term description, whether the term is current or not, total number of types of TIP subjects offered and materials needed, the minimum and maximum number of enrolled students, the total number of schools offering subjects, and the total number of records for each term code?
gold_sql: SELECT at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses, COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS Total_Materials, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Min_Enrolled_Students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Max_Enrolled_Students, COUNT(DISTINCT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS Total_Num_Schools, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS Total_Records FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at LEFT OUTER JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_tip_subjects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS total_materials,
    MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
    MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_schools,
    SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records
FROM 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
JOIN 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY 
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_types_of_tip_subjects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS total_materials_needed,
    MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
    MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_schools_offering_subjects,
    SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records
FROM 
    ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
JOIN 
    TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
JOIN 
    TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN 
    TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY 
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM;

question: List all buildings with their names, building numbers, building height, street address, city, state, HR department name, assignable square footage, total and average square footage, ordered in descending order of assignable, total, and average square footage.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT new.BUILDING_NAME, new.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT, new.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, new.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, new.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, new.Total_Square_Footage, new.Avg_Square_Footage_Per_Room FROM (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, SUM(fr.AREA) AS Total_Square_Footage, AVG(fr.AREA) AS Avg_Square_Footage_Per_Room FROM BUILDINGS b JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) new JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON new.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb ON new.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' ORDER BY new.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC, new.Total_Square_Footage DESC, new.Avg_Square_Footage_Per_Room DESC;
sql_baseline:
SELECT 
    B.BUILDING_NAME, 
    B.BUILDING_NUMBER, 
    FB.BUILDING_HEIGHT, 
    B.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    A.CITY, 
    A.STATE, 
    O.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    B.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 
    SUM(R.AREA) AS TOTAL_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 
    AVG(R.AREA) AS AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
FROM 
    BUILDINGS B
JOIN 
    FAC_BUILDING FB ON B.BUILDING_KEY = FB.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    FAC_ROOMS R ON FB.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = R.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS A ON B.BUILDING_KEY = A.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    FAC_ORGANIZATION O ON R.ORGANIZATION_KEY = O.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY 
    B.BUILDING_NAME, 
    B.BUILDING_NUMBER, 
    FB.BUILDING_HEIGHT, 
    B.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    A.CITY, 
    A.STATE, 
    O.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    B.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
ORDER BY 
    B.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC, 
    TOTAL_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC, 
    AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC;
sql_agg:
SELECT 
    B.BUILDING_NAME, 
    B.BUILDING_NUMBER, 
    FB.BUILDING_HEIGHT, 
    B.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    A.CITY, 
    A.STATE, 
    O.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    B.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 
    SUM(R.AREA) AS TOTAL_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 
    AVG(R.AREA) AS AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
FROM 
    BUILDINGS B
JOIN 
    FAC_BUILDING FB ON B.BUILDING_KEY = FB.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS A ON B.BUILDING_KEY = A.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    FAC_ROOMS R ON B.BUILDING_KEY = R.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN 
    FAC_ORGANIZATION O ON R.ORGANIZATION_KEY = O.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY 
    B.BUILDING_NAME, 
    B.BUILDING_NUMBER, 
    FB.BUILDING_HEIGHT, 
    B.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, 
    A.CITY, 
    A.STATE, 
    O.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
    B.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
ORDER BY
